issues: The site remained closed after the 11/10 fire and is being prepared to reopen on Friday 30/10.
GBHK is pushing to hand the unit back on Wednesday 28/10 (Admin Meeting 26/10).
Srawut has sent the new shelving, food and damaged equipment orders to Junna, who is processing them, and the food order was being placed on 26/10 (Admin Meeting 26/10).

FOH come in on Wednesday evening, then Thursday is a full day of deep cleaning, reorganising and deep prep for the weekend; the professional clean was moved to Thursday because there is no water supply yet, and Sophie will work with the team over the reopening weekend (Admin Meeting 26/10).
Marketing planned to post a reopening update video on 26/10 once behind the scenes content of the works came in (Admin Meeting 26/10).

The shelving order was to be placed on Monday 26/10 once the team compiled the list, cleaners were booked for Thursday, and Coke and equipment representatives were due on Thursday to check the equipment (Birmingham Project Meeting 23/10).
Spencer reported lots of cleaning done, with Jimmy deep cleaning the bar and items added to the checklist; most staff are in on Wednesday and Thursday.

The original ice machine produces very little ice; Ross will get a new one (not the same brand as the one that caught fire) once it is added to the broken equipment list, and the microwave is the other worst item.

The Sakura flowers and ropes are heavily dusty and greyed or blackened; Ross will ask the cleaning company for advice, and if that fails the Sakura can be replaced from stock at the Mercium warehouse, which last time took four or five days and needs three or four people with ladders.
The new printer and card machine have been delivered and a new point of sale is in, but Kobas is still not working correctly; the music is back on.

The heating is blowing more like air con, so Nathan will check it tomorrow; Amy asked Nathan to run a printer cable to the middle of the till, and Ross suggested a £10 network switch from Amazon to split the port.
Extra storage such as wait stations in front of the bar is still needed.
Inka will be on site on Thursday to check everything before the Friday reopening, with Amy supporting; staffing should be sufficient, and the glass washers will be cleaned again on Thursday.
Dojo bookings are not open yet and need reopening for Friday.
Stock orders for Birmingham were placed on Kobas on 27/10 for delivery on 29/10 (Kobas order confirmations 27/10).
Birmingham ad campaigns were stopped while the site was closed (Weekly DPM Meeting 27/10).
Stock brought from Birmingham to Nottingham (Red Bull, orange juice and pineapple juice) still needs a stock transfer.

Region: the new Christmas set menu (including a set menu for large bookings) brings three new dishes; head chefs must check stock and have everything ready by Friday 30/10, leaflets must be ready by Friday (nudge marketing if they are late) and an allergy sheet is needed for the new dishes.
Region: the lunch deal continues through half term this week on a flexible basis, offered only when customers ask for it.
Region: the £5 ramen promotion ends on Saturday 31/10, and a new loyalty tier promotion will follow, probably announced at next Tuesday's KPI meeting.
Region: delivery prep times have improved overall across the region; this week's focus is disputing inaccurate orders as quickly as possible.
